item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena counts the neem trees growing in her school garden in Jaipur on one morning in March. Her friend says this count is a population. Which condition must be true for Meena's count to be a population?

options.A: The count includes every plant and animal living anywhere in Jaipur.
options.B: The count includes only neem trees, all counted in the same school garden at the same time.
options.C: The count includes neem, mango and peepal trees counted in different gardens on different days.
options.D: The count includes all the neem trees in India, estimated from a book.
